content.short: Base Bridge is the official tool for securely transferring ETH and other assets between Ethereum and the Base network.
content.description:
Base Bridge is the official cross-chain infrastructure designed to facilitate the transfer of assets between the Ethereum mainnet and the Base network, a Layer 2 solution developed by Coinbase. It serves as the primary gateway for users to "bridge" their ETH and other supported tokens, enabling them to pay for transaction fees and interact with the diverse ecosystem of dApps on Base. The bridge operates through decentralized smart contracts, ensuring the security and integrity of all transfers.

While bridging from Ethereum to Base is typically instantaneous, the withdrawal process back to the mainnet follows standard security protocols for optimistic rollups, which can take several days. As a foundational component of the Base ecosystem, the bridge lowers the barrier to entry for users seeking faster and cheaper transactions on an Ethereum-secured Layer 2. Base Bridge remains a critical tool for anyone looking to explore the growing world of decentralized applications on Base.
